name: Performance Review / 1-on-1
description: Capture structured notes from employee performance reviews and recurring 1-on-1 meetings, including goals, feedback, and action items.

sections.title: Meeting Overview
sections.instruction: Summarize the type of meeting (annual review, mid-year check-in, weekly 1-on-1, etc.), the participants, and the primary focus or purpose of the conversation.

sections.title: Participants
sections.instruction: List the employee, manager, and any other attendees. Note their roles or titles if mentioned.

sections.title: Performance Highlights
sections.instruction: Summarize the key accomplishments, strengths, and positive contributions discussed during the meeting.

sections.title: Areas for Growth & Feedback
sections.instruction: Capture constructive feedback, development opportunities, skill gaps, or behavioral areas mentioned for improvement.

sections.title: Goals & Objectives
sections.instruction: List current goals reviewed, new goals set, and any goal adjustments discussed. Include timelines or metrics where mentioned.

sections.title: Employee Input & Concerns
sections.instruction: Summarize anything raised by the employee — questions, concerns, requests for support, career aspirations, or general feedback about their role or team.

sections.title: Action Items & Follow-Up
sections.instruction: List all commitments made by either party, including who owns each item and any deadlines discussed.
